description.from:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Type: Campaign

The **unit of work**. A bet over a window. Goal is a **hire conversation**, not reach.

Babulus is a campaign factory: AI agents (Chattic.us) and a human steer production of the whole campaign until the checklist is complete and on time.

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **goal**: hire conversation (not impressions / reach)
- **dates**: window start / end
- **track**: `hire` | `human`
- **checklist**: required deliverables (LandingPage, Video if any, ImageSet, SocialCopy, PpcCopy)
- Publicist governs; Ryan approves before anything is queued or handed off

## States

`planned` → `briefing` → `in_production` → `ready` → `live` → `closed`

Agents claim child work by type and state until the checklist is complete and on time.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> planned
  planned --> briefing
  briefing --> in_production
  in_production --> ready
  ready --> live
  live --> closed
  closed --> [*]
```

## Out of scope

- Do not ship a Campaign type this week
- Do not post live
- Do not replace inbound MarketingProgram / MarketingLead
description.to:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. Publicist accepted.

## Type: Campaign

The unit of work for **outbound owned-media**. A bet over a window. Goal is a hire conversation, not reach.

**Namespace:** Babulus Campaign. **Do NOT collide** with inbound Marketo Program / Smart Campaign. Those objects stay inbound and keep their names.

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **goal**: hire conversation
- **dates**: window start / end
- **track**: `hire` | `human`
- **brief**: attached Brief (intake)
- **checklist**: Deliverables spawned from the Brief (`kind` enum, not five types)
- UTM, brand kit, LP SLA, legal are **fields/states**, not types

## States

`planned` → `briefing` → `in_production` → `ready` → `live` → `closed`

Agents claim child work until the checklist is complete and on time.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> planned
  planned --> briefing
  briefing --> in_production
  in_production --> ready
  ready --> live
  live --> closed
```

## Out of scope

- Do not implement
- Do not post live
- Do not rename or replace Marketo Program / Smart Campaign
